ruleDefinitions.name: Interactive Bash Suspicious Children
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious interactive bash as a parent to rather uncommon child processes

sequences.query: parent_process_command_line = "bash\ \-i" AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-c\\ import\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*base64.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pty\\\.spawn.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("whoami$") OR process_path = RGX("iptables$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ncat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/nc$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/netcat$")))
